topics.topic: Whether absent lifecycle fields are initialized empty as an exception or must be supplied by creation changes
questions: Must fields absent from a creation change be initialized to None or the empty tuple as the new passage requires, or must every non-module-assigned field come from the change as given?
Must the new empty initialization rule be an explicit exception to "every other field, times included, comes from the change as given," or must the creation changes carry these initial values?
Must these lifecycle fields be initialized empty even though the creation changes do not carry them, or must every non-module-assigned field come from the change as given?

quotes: The module alone assigns, inside the transaction: store positions; the random identities trial_execution_id, binding_id, run_id, approval_id and grant_id, drawn from a cryptographically secure source and drawn again on a collision, which is a drawn identity for which the row's load operation finds a row; the attempt_number of the records its derivation note lists; and every by-field (issued_by, created_by, submitted_by, added_by, activated_by, executed_by, proposed_by, accepted_by, authored_by, started_by, cancelled_by, resumed_by, released_by, decided_by, granted_by, revoked_by, resolved_by) from the actor argument; and each status the field-assignment note of a variant says it writes or sets (proposed, accepted, requested, approved, refused, active, revoked, in_flight and the rest); every other field, times included, comes from the change as given.

A field of a record that its change does not carry and this module does not assign is empty when the record is first written, None for an optional field and the empty tuple for a tuple field, and only the later change that names it sets it: decided_by and decided_at of an EffectApproval by DecideApprovalChange; concluded_at of an EffectAttempt by RecordAttemptOutcomeChange or RecoverInFlightChange and its resolved_by by ResolveAttemptChange; accepted_by and accepted_at of an OperationBinding by AcceptBindingChange; outputs, waiting, ended_at and cancelled_by of a Run by RecordRunProgressChange, its resumptions by RecordResumptionChange, and released_by and released_at by ReleaseRunChange; revoked_by and revoked_at of a StandingGrant by RevokeChange.
judgement.why: The new passage requires initial empty values for fields absent from creation changes, while the existing passage says every non-module-assigned field comes from the change as given.

topics.topic: Whether RecordSet fields absent from ShownRecords are omitted or copied unchanged
questions: Must RecordSet fields absent from ShownRecords be omitted as the first passage requires, or copied unchanged as the second passage requires?
Must RecordSet fields that ShownRecords lacks never be shown, or must every other RecordSet field be copied into ShownRecords unchanged?
Must RecordSet fields that ShownRecords lacks be omitted because they are not listable, or copied unchanged despite no corresponding ShownRecords fields existing?

quotes: MUST show each listed record that another handler answers alone as that handler shows it: a TrialCase as handle_add_trial_case, a TrialExecution as handle_try_implementation, a NodeExecution as handle_get_repair_view, a FlowVersion as handle_compose_flow_version, an Implementation as handle_get_implementation and a Run as handle_start_run; a record whose ShownRecords field has the same type as the RecordSet field of the same name is listed unchanged, and a RecordSet field that ShownRecords lacks belongs to a type that is not listable and is never shown.

MUST show each listed record that another handler answers alone as that handler shows it: a TrialCase as handle_add_trial_case, a TrialExecution as handle_try_implementation, a NodeExecution as handle_get_repair_view, a FlowVersion as handle_compose_flow_version, an Implementation as handle_get_implementation and a Run as handle_start_run; every other field of the RecordSet is copied into ShownRecords unchanged.
judgement.why: The first passage requires fields absent from ShownRecords never to be shown, while the second requires every other RecordSet field to be copied into ShownRecords.

topics.topic: Whether approvals are projected to ShownApproval with preview or copied as EffectApproval
questions: Must approvals be converted to ShownApproval with a ShownApprovalPreview, or copied unchanged from RecordSet as EffectApproval?

quotes: MUST show an approval as ShownApproval with every field of the EffectApproval copied except preview, which becomes ShownApprovalPreview with service_id, operation_name and effect_class copied from the ApprovalPreview and its inputs and request as the security-boundary note of this handler says (A07, K-15).

MUST show each listed record that another handler answers alone as that handler shows it: a TrialCase as handle_add_trial_case, a TrialExecution as handle_try_implementation, a NodeExecution as handle_get_repair_view, a FlowVersion as handle_compose_flow_version, an Implementation as handle_get_implementation and a Run as handle_start_run; every other field of the RecordSet is copied into ShownRecords unchanged.
judgement.why: The approval-specific passage requires conversion to ShownApproval, while the catch-all passage requires the approvals field to be copied unchanged.

topics.topic: Whether effect_attempts are projected to ShownEffectAttempt or copied as EffectAttempt
questions: Must effect_attempts be converted to ShownEffectAttempt, or copied unchanged from RecordSet as EffectAttempt?

quotes: MUST show an effect attempt as ShownEffectAttempt with every field of the EffectAttempt copied and its inputs passed through show_port_refs for the actor, never as the EffectAttempt itself (decision 24, A07 rule 4).

MUST show each listed record that another handler answers alone as that handler shows it: a TrialCase as handle_add_trial_case, a TrialExecution as handle_try_implementation, a NodeExecution as handle_get_repair_view, a FlowVersion as handle_compose_flow_version, an Implementation as handle_get_implementation and a Run as handle_start_run; every other field of the RecordSet is copied into ShownRecords unchanged.
judgement.why: The effect-attempt-specific passage forbids returning EffectAttempt unchanged, while the catch-all passage requires that RecordSet field to be copied unchanged.
